subject: Aureon Systems workshop — proposed windows & room needs
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Cara Ellis <cara.ellis@aureon.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Aureon Systems workshop — proposed windows & room needs

Hi Cara,

Thanks again for taking time earlier this week. We want to lock the logistics for the two-day "Aureon Strategy & Ops" workshop so your team can start booking travel. High-level ask from our side: confirm a preferred date window, headcount split (in-person vs remote), and any AV/breakout requirements so we can reserve the right rooms at your site (or secure hybrid rooms if you prefer Redwood to host).

Proposed windows (CEST):
- Tue Aug 10 — Wed Aug 11 (full days 09:00–17:00)
- Mon Aug 23 — Tue Aug 24 (full days 09:00–17:00)
- Alternate single-day option: Wed Aug 25 (09:00–16:00) if leadership availability is tight

Room & AV checklist (for your ops team):
- Main plenary: 20–25 pax seating, projector + speakers, laptop HDMI & USB-C adapter
- 2x breakout rooms for ~6 each, whiteboards and flip charts
- One hybrid setup (camera + table mics) for ~6 remote attendees
- Catering windows: 10:00 coffee, 12:30 lunch, 15:00 snack

Attached: Aureon_Workshop_Room_Specs.pdf and Draft_MAP_v2.xlsx — the specs show the minimum room footprint and a suggested table layout.

Can you confirm which of the two windows works for Aureon and share the onsite contact for facilities so Monica can coordinate room booking and AV tests? If you want Redwood to provide a hybrid kit and an AV tech for the day, we can include that in the engagement (we'll need a plug-and-play table and power access).

Thanks — I’ll pencil both Aug 10–11 and Aug 23–24 as soft holds on our side until we hear back.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

Attachments: Aureon_Workshop_Room_Specs.pdf (PDF), Draft_MAP_v2.xlsx (Excel)

From: Cara Ellis <cara.ellis@aureon.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: James Tanner <j.tanner@aureon.com>, procurement@aureon.com
Date: 2026-06-20T13:45:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Aureon Systems workshop — proposed windows & room needs

Thanks Sean — appreciate the clarity. Aug 23–24 works best for our execs (CEST). Our onsite logistics lead is James Tanner (cc'd) and procurement is in the loop.

Quick details from our side:
- In-person headcount: 18 (Aureon product + strategy + two execs)
- Remote attendees: 6 (engineering leads joining from remote locations)
- AV: we need one hybrid room with camera + table mic; breakout rooms can be smaller huddle rooms with whiteboards
- Catering: light lunch and coffee service; two dietary restrictions (vegetarian + gluten-free)

We'd like Redwood to provide the hybrid kit and an AV tech for a pre-check on the morning of Aug 23. If you can include a rough estimate for AV tech hours and equipment, we can route the cost through procurement.

Also — we prefer the main session start at 09:30 local on Aug 23 (exec availability).

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-06-21T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aureon Systems workshop — space & AV lead assignment

Thanks team — copying logistics notes so we have an internal tracker. Cara confirmed Aug 23–24, 09:30 start on day one, 18 in-person / 6 remote. Procurement (James) is looped on the commercial side.

Actions I propose (internal):
- Marissa: hold two rooms in our vendor partner list (one plenary 20p, two breakouts) and confirm hybrid-capable room availability by EOD Friday 6/25. I attached a quick screenshot of room specs we typically use.
- Karthik: assign the AV tech (estimated 6 hours + travel) and provide an equipment list and rough estimate we can share with procurement.
- Sean: draft a calendar hold & a simple run-of-show and send to Cara (include a pre-check slot on the morning of Aug 23 for AV tech).

Notes: if Aureon wants Redwood to ship our portable hybrid kit, that'll require customs lead time for EU shipping — let's flag that if they confirm equipment rental. If we can't ship, partner on-site AV is acceptable.

Attached: RoomBooking_Specs_v1.png, Travel_Assignee_List.docx

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Cara — great, Aug 23–24 locked from our side with a 09:30 start on day one. I've created tentative calendar holds for the sessions and included a 45-minute AV pre-check on Aug 23 at 08:00 CEST (link below). Please consider these soft holds until procurement signs off on the AV estimate.

What we're sending next:
- Marissa will confirm the rooms and provide exact addresses + ingress instructions (target 6/25).
- Karthik will send the AV estimate and equipment spec by tomorrow (ET).
- Monica will share the run-of-show draft for timeboxing and breaks.

Calendar & docs: https://calendar.redwood.com/event?eid=AZX123456
CRM: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CRM-3421

Thanks — Sean
